lab standard]. Plate reader. Computer room / laptops
Exp 1 is a real experiment: five trypan-blue counts from Tuesday 14:00 to Thursday 15:00 (about 0, 19, 25, 43 and 49 h) give a growth curve and a doubling
time against the published 15 to 24 h; the MTT columns are a second readout, viability of your own vial after the break the third. Counts come from the
counting wells, one well per count, so the flask is only touched for the medium change and the freeze. P09 steps are 5 to 20 minute visits; the dry-lab
pair pops over. Good Friday 26 March: no course.
Facility slot: cytometer, facility lecture (fixed, reserved)
Wet lab Exp 1: establish the line (growth curve, freeze, re-thaw)
Wet lab Exp 2: challenge, read out (flow cytometry, ELISA)
Dry lab and desk work: setup, analysis, planning
Poster and writing: introduction, significance, figures
